name: Broadcasted Soldier Patrol
philosophy: Reactive Soldier Orbit was too free-form; broadcasting a rally direction keeps soldiers patrolling close and only chasing when we have coordinated intel.
key_changes: Have RobotPlayer.runArchon() write the current rally direction to two new shared channels whenever the safe arc is stable.
Update RobotPlayer.runSoldier() to consult those rally channels, move along that vector when no enemies are sensed, and only chase fresh sightings.
engagement_style: Orbiting the rally beacon with conditional pursuit on fresh contact.
